# Logging and SIEM: References

Always prefer current vendor documentation for the installed version. Defaults, file paths, and option
names change between major versions (Wazuh in particular). Re-verify links and contents when updating
this skill.

Last verified: 2026-10-31

## Vendor (authoritative)

### Wazuh

- Architecture and default ports: https://documentation.wazuh.com/current/getting-started/architecture.html
- Password management (changing default and generated passwords): https://documentation.wazuh.com/current/user-manual/user-administration/password-management.html
- Agent enrollment with password authentication: https://documentation.wazuh.com/current/user-manual/agent/agent-enrollment/security-options/using-password-authentication.html
- Active response: https://documentation.wazuh.com/current/user-manual/capabilities/active-response/index.html

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- Community Graylog and Wazuh compose files and tutorials frequently ship example passwords or password
  hashes. Useful for understanding a deployment's origin; treat any credential in them as public.
